# Redis TCL Scope

In scope:

- unit/type/string
- unit/type/hash
- unit/type/list
- unit/type/set
- unit/type/zset
- unit/expire
- unit/scan
- unit/multi
- unit/keyspace
- unit/networking
- unit/pubsub

Whole-file exclusions:

- unit/cluster: Redis Cluster hash-slot routing is not Mako's sharding API.
- unit/sentinel: Sentinel is Redis's monitoring/failover control plane.
- unit/moduleapi: Mako does not expose the Redis module ABI.
- unit/dump, unit/rdb, unit/aof: Redis persistence internals are replaced by
  Mako storage/replication paths.
- unit/scripting: run and reported since package 8, but not gated. The adapter
  implements the EVAL/EVALSHA/SCRIPT command surface; that file also tests
  Redis's scripting internals (LDB, function and effects replication, the
  global-protection sandbox, RESP3 inside scripts), which this adapter does not
  claim.
- unit/type/stream, unit/type/stream-cgroups: run and reported since package 9,
  but not gated, in the same way unit/scripting is. The adapter implements the
  whole stream command surface; those two files also assert Redis's radix-tree
  macro-node trimming granularity, its private RDB stream payload, its
  `rdb_changes_since_last_save` bookkeeping and a 10,000-command MULTI this
  executor cannot take, none of which this adapter claims. The failures and
  their reasons are in known_divergences.txt.
- ACL/TLS/client-cache files: outside this Redis layer scope.

The TCL guard is an external-server semantic test. It should not be used to
validate Redis internals that Mako deliberately does not implement.
